svg.text: W12 · Domains, publishing and invitations · AWK-7 · 2026-10-14
Builds on W5 B (published view). One screen per job: Domains for the organisation, Publish per survey, Invite from Publish. Defaults first, details behind More.
A · Organisation menu → Domains (owners and admins) · EN
Where respondents open your surveys. The primary domain is used for links, QR codes, the PDF and invitations.
Certificate issued automatically on the first visit.
Add these two records at your DNS provider, then press Verify. DNS changes can take up to an hour.

The CNAME points to another address (old-host.example). Fix the record and press Verify again.
Use a subdomain you own; the main website stays where it is.

D · Publish → Participants (after sending): who got what · EN
118 sent · 2 bounced · 61 answered · 9 started · reminder planned Fri 25 Oct
Invitations can't be sent yet. Copy each
person's link, or download them all.
An owner sets up email in Instance settings.
E · Phone · Domains and the published view stack; invitations are sent from a desktop

1 Domains is one screen (architecture.md). The system subdomain is always ready; one domain is primary (links, QR, PDF, invitations). ⋯ = Make primary, Remove. Removing the primary makes the system domain primary.

2 A new domain shows its CNAME and TXT records with Copy; Verify checks DNS now, and Askwerk checks again by itself every few minutes for 7 days. With Caddy, the certificate comes on the first visit; with another proxy the screen says certificates are the operator's job.
3 Inline checks: a hostname, not a URL; not already used by another organisation; not the base domain itself. Every change is in the audit log.

4 Publish: one address switch (verified domains, primary first); link, QR, embed snippet and PDF all follow it. Survey links get a short code (kz26b7) instead of the long id; old /s/{id} links keep working.
5 Embed: script or iframe; only on websites the organisation allows (Settings → Embed, its own small screen later).
6 'Invite participants…' opens C. Without SMTP it still works: personal links to copy or download (D, 10).
7 Paste or file; duplicates are skipped, bad lines named. Participants are kept per survey; an organisation-wide contact list (data-model.md Contact) comes with the host sync (AWK-12/14).

8 The texts come from Organisation → Messages (W10 D); 'Answer by' fills {deadline}. One reminder by default to those who have not answered; More for a second one. Sending runs as a background job (first job of the job table).

9 Status per person: Sent, Opened link, Started, Answered, Bounced, Unsubscribed. Copy link for one person; ⋯ = resend, remove. Anonymous surveys show only Sent / Answered, never which answers are whose.

Open for Dražan: (a) short survey codes in links (recommended) or keep the long id; (b) an unsubscribe link in every invitation, and unsubscribed people are never invited again by the organisation (recommended).
